{"id":1850824376,"question_id":3885,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765262913,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"377 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1850824376/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Special Triplets","memory":"310.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    const int mod = 1e9 + 7;\n    int specialTriplets(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        vector<int>suffix(1e5+1 , 0);\n        vector<int>prefix(1e5+1 , 0);\n\n        for(auto n : nums) suffix[n]++;\n\n        long long count = 0;\n        for(int i=0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            int val = nums[i];\n            int target = val * 2;\n\n            suffix[val]--;\n\n            if(target <= 1e5)\n            {\n                long long left_occ = prefix[target];\n                long long right_occ = suffix[target];\n                count = (count + (left_occ * right_occ) % mod) % mod;\n            }\n            \n            prefix[val]++;\n        }\n    return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-special-triplets","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1289}
